children: PAIR, a multi-pool RWA token issuance platform on Robinhood Chain, said its cumulative trading volume has approached $100 million, creator rewards have exceeded $600,000, and more than 2,000 projects have launched on the protocol. According to ChainCatcher, the platform also said it has burned more than $3 million worth of PAIR tokens, representing over 10% of the total supply. PAIR added that it will announce what it described as its largest update to date within the next 24 hours.

title: PAIR Reports Nearly $100 Million in Trading Volume and Teases Major Update
